The code uses CONFIG.waveSeconds, and a message that mentions a setting builds it from CONFIG ("You start with " + CONFIG.startCoins + " coins"), so changing the setting changes the message too. If the file has a CONFIG, add new settings to it and change a setting there; never make a second one. Real names only: levelup, exp_collect, coinsDrop, cashRegister, beep, chestOpen, firecracker1, magicAccent1, horrorFright, ZombieGrunt1.\n- Particles: api.playParticleEffect({ presetId: "aura", pos1: [x, y, z], pos2: [x + 1, y + 2, z + 1] }); a preset takes only presetId, pos1, pos2. Real presetIds: aura, stomp, mobDeath, mobSpawnOrb, speedOuter, glowingOuter, redFirecrackerLarge (or blue, green...); no "portal" or "sparkle".\n- Shapes: customButtons [{ id: "dash", icon: "house", keycode: "KeyR" }] (no text); giveItem attributes { customDisplayName }; configureShopCategory { customTitle, sortPriority } (no icon); editItemCraftingRecipes [{ requires: [{ items: ["Leather"], amt: 3 }], produces: 1 }].\n- A player's name: api.getEntityName(playerId).\n- Flying: api.setClientOption(playerId, "creative", true) (false to stop).\n- Leaderboard: in onPlayerJoin, api.setClientOption(playerId, "lobbyLeaderboardInfo", { name: { displayName: "Name", sortPriority: 0 }, coins: { displayName: "Coins", sortPriority: 1 } }); then whenever a value changes, api.setTargetedPlayerSettingForEveryone(playerId, "lobbyLeaderboardValues", { coins: 5 }, true).\n- Text on the right of the screen: api.setClientOption(playerId, "RightInfoText", "Coins: 5").\n- Full health: api.setHealth(playerId, api.getClientOption(playerId, "maxHealth")).\n- Teleporting somewhere nearby: change x and z only, and keep y (or add a little so they drop onto the ground), e.g. const [x, y, z] = api.getPosition(playerId); api.setPosition(playerId, x + dx, y + 5, z + dz).\n- Positions: api.getPosition(playerId) is the player's feet. The block under them is api.getBlock(Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y) - 1, Math.floor(z)).\n- A player who can't play any more (e.g. out of lives): api.setPlayerGamemode(playerId, "spectator"); "survival" brings them back.\n- Mob waves: api.attemptSpawnMob(mobType, x, y, z) returns the mob's id. Keep the ids, and remove each in onMobDespawned(mobId) to know when they are all dead.\n- Removing or changing a block later: count ms in tick, then api.setBlock(x, y, z, "Air").\n- Coins as a currency: make it once in onPlayerJoin, only if they don't have it yet (a saved one comes back by itself, and setCurrency again would reset it): if (api.getCurrencyAmount(playerId, "coins") === null) api.setCurrency(playerId, "coins", { amount: 0, icon: "coins" }).
